basis.means: Only posts that kept their line breaks. The scraping console returns most posts as one unbroken line, and counting those would report the scraper as a habit of the writer.

whose_they_are.josh_eight: The eight Josh chose, for their storytelling structure. THIS IS THE STANDARD. Where the two corpora disagree about what a good opening looks like, these win. Engagement exists for mattjbarker1 only.
whose_they_are.content_agent: Clients of the sibling content-agent project, read from its on-disk caches. Not Josh's writers and never to be reported as them. Their value is volume, fourteen more voices, and engagement on almost every post — which his own corpus does not have.
whose_they_are.console_store: The scraping console's harvest store, headlines only, accounts with eight or more posts. Widest and weakest: nobody chose these accounts and the bodies are flat. Present for first-line volume and engagement, and for nothing else. See source_c_caveat.

basis.source_c_caveat: HOOKS ONLY, and its line one is a first SENTENCE rather than a first line. The scraping console stopped preserving line breaks around 28 September 2026 — verified 2 November, 200 consecutive rows with zero newlines — so its bodies cannot be measured for shape at all. What survives is the `headline` field, present on every row and a prefix of the body in 98% of them, which is enough for a hook and nothing else. Accounts with fewer than eight posts are dropped: the store is a feed scrape and most of its handles contribute one conference check-in. Opt in with --console; it is not in a default build.
basis.source_b_caveat: Working creators, not a structure reference. Some of it is personal-brand marketing that his rules do not name and therefore do not exclude. Use source B for volume, for the fold distribution and for engagement evidence; use source A for what a good opening is.

what_these_are: STRUCTURE ONLY. No sentence from any post is in this file, and the run refuses to write if one is. Take the shape, never the words (8.3) — and create_draft refuses any draft sharing a seven-word run with a stored reference post, so a borrowed opening would not file anyway.
the_number_claim_caveat: `number_claim` means a number ABOUT THE WRITER, not any number. openingShape requires a figure AND a first-person pronoun in the same line (scripts/lib/prose.mjs), so "3,941 practices, read one at a time off a vendor's booking page" classifies as `statement` despite leading on a figure. Found 2 November by running candidate hooks through the classifier. It is not a bug — the distinction is real and useful — but a drafter aiming at `number_claim` has to put himself in the line, and nothing said so before.
the_statement_caveat: `statement` is the largest bucket and is not a shape. It is openingShape()'s fallthrough: the openings that matched none of the other six (scripts/lib/prose.mjs:88). Aiming at it means aiming at none of the above, which is not an instruction.
approximations: line_one_words, share_pct, hook_clears_the_fold_pct and first_figure_arrives rest on stored columns counted by scripts/lib/prose.mjs. names_the_reader_pct and investment_elements_in_line_one are REGEX APPROXIMATIONS of prose judgements: they see form, never meaning. A line can name real stakes in words no list holds. Report them as estimates or not at all.

definitions.names_the_reader: A job title, a team noun or a direct address in line one. The hooks section calls this the highest-value tool available. Cannot tell a department from a noun; misses any title not on the list.
definitions.investment_elements: How many of specificity, stakes and emotion line one carries, by word list. The hooks section says a hook missing all three cannot be rescued by a better cut. Specificity is a figure or a non-initial capitalised word; the other two are word lists.
definitions.first_figure_arrives: Where the post's first digit appears. A post whose figures all arrive after line one has withheld something. Blind to a finding that is not a number; counts a date as a figure.

investment_components_pct.emotion_withdrawn: Cut on 2 November after validation. 22% recall against 20 hand-labelled openings — it found two of every nine that genuinely carry an emotion. The 2.9% it used to report was a fact about a word list, not about writers. scripts/validate-investment.mjs.

investment_detector_accuracy.specificity: not scored — a figure or a proper noun is a mechanical test, not a reading
investment_detector_accuracy.means: Stakes finds about two thirds of the openings that carry them and is right about three in five of the ones it flags, missing implied risk and firing on 'cost' and 'dead' used in another sense. Use it as an indication and never as a count.

statement_is_really.means: Shares of the statement bucket, not of the whole corpus. Aiming at `statement` is aiming at none of the other six shapes; these say which move the line actually makes.

line_two.means: A low share means these writers mostly do NOT answer line one in line two — which is the stacked-gap move his hooks section describes. It counts figures only, so a line that resolves in words is invisible to it.

reactions_by_fold_use.means: 1.00 is that author's own median post.
reactions_by_fold_use.how_much_to_trust_it: SUGGESTIVE, NOT A MEASUREMENT. The buckets rest on FOLD_CHARS_PER_LINE = 42 and FOLD_LINES = 3, both flagged PROVISIONAL in shape.ts and never fitted against a real phone. The spread is about 20% and the direction is worth acting on; the figure is not something to quote at Josh as a finding.

excluded_by_his_rules.why_a_filter: His hooks section has two nevers and one of them is No bait. The widest-reaching opening in the content-agent store is a bait-and-switch — a marathon time, three promised business lessons, then "No, I'm joking haha." Ranking by engagement and learning from the top would teach the drafter the one move his rules forbid outright.
excluded_by_his_rules.what_judged_it: scan() from mcp-server/aitells.mjs, which encodes the constructions his library rules out, plus his rule against opening on a question. Not a second opinion about what slop is.
by_reason: opens on a question (his rule, hooks section)
